changed_factor: hold/exit behavior of fixed overlay only
scaler: reuse each frozen origin scaler; no fitting
delayed_entry: allowed when gate later opens in same EMA episode
held_position: retain while finite EMA direction is unchanged even when gate closes
missing_features: force flat exactly as EMA; never hold through invalid features
reversal: close old position; fresh gate required for opposite entry
temporal_contract: unchanged 365d train, 28h purge, 30d validation, 28h purge, 3d test, 3d cadence
smoke_acceptance: engineering parity, causality, policy invariants and accounting only; never filter by returns
early_stop: only invariant failures or resource/safety failure; no performance-based stopping
